item.title: Hitozuma Juurin Shiiku ~Himei ga Kyousei ni Kawaru made Shitsukete Yaru!~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monogram
  • 発売日: 2013-05-17
  • スコア: 5.9799999999999995/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 人妻蹂躙飼育 ～悲鳴が嬌声に変わるまで躾けてやる！～
  • 英語名: Hitozuma Juurin Shiiku Himei ga Kyousei ni Kawaru made Shitsukete Yaru!

あらすじ

“Mmh, mmh, mmmmmmmmhhhh…!”

“Well, I’ll be off, then…”

Toshihiro Mizuguchi leaves his home and heads off for work.

The muffled groans of a woman behind him fade into the distance…

He arrives at work, sits at his desk, and glances over at his boss, Tsukasa Mochizuki.

item.title: Segare no Niizuma
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monogram
  • 発売日: 2013-04-19
  • スコア: 5.88/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: せがれの新妻
  • 英語名: Segare no Niizuma

あらすじ

Half a year ago, I lost my wife, my one and only, to a traffic accident.

Overwhelmed by grief, I shut myself inside my house.

And, almost as though to spite me, my son gets married to a lovely woman.

And as if that wasn’t bad enough, they offer to move in with me, and I’m forced to bear witness to their happy married life.

item.title: Kyonyuubo ~Okaa-san wa Dare ni mo Watasanai~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monogram
  • 発売日: 2013-03-15
  • スコア: 6.14/10 (39 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巨乳母 ～お母さんは誰にも渡さない～
  • 英語名: Kyonyuubo Okaa-san wa Dare ni mo Watasanai

あらすじ

My parents have been separated for several years now.

All because my father cheated on my mom.

How could he cheat on a woman as wonderful as her? He’s no father of mine.

And missing that dirtbag was the furthest thing from my mind.

In fact, I was glad that mom and I got to live together by ourselves.

  • 英語名: Oyako no Himitsu Tsuma ni Ienai Oyako no Kankei

あらすじ

It’s Ryoutaro’s daughter Risa’s birthday. He buys her a gift from a department store but she seems more distant and aloof than ever. He wakes up to find himself completely enveloped in his daughter’s vagina. She’s been waiting for her birthday to give her virginity to him and finding him asleep was the perfect opportunity.

item.title: Iinari Seito Kaichou ~Nikuyoku ni Ochiru Gakuen Idol~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monogram
  • 発売日: 2013-01-18
  • スコア: 5.49/10 (8 人評価)
  • 日本語名: いいなり生徒会長 ～肉欲に堕ちる学園アイドル～
  • 英語名: Iinari Seito Kaichou Nikuyoku ni Ochiru Gakuen Idol

あらすじ

I, Naoki Sugimura, am walking down an empty hallway after school. I’m the vice president of the student council, and I’d just been discussing the budget for the soccer club… but it went on for far longer than it was meant to.

I only became the vice president because I don’t do any club activities and I needed something to boost my school report.

item.title: Oyako Kouryuu ~Kahanshin Kotoba de Communication~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Monogram
  • 発売日: 2012-12-14
  • スコア: 5.49/10 (25 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 親娘交流 ～下半身言語でコミュニケーション～
  • 英語名: Oyako Kouryuu Kahanshin Kotoba de Communication

あらすじ

Takatoshi’s daughter Ako has run away from home. With nowhere to go she sells herself as a prostitute. One night’s stay in exchange for sex. Calling herself Shiina, Takatoshi hires his own daughter. In a darkened room he meets her and the two have sex but when the lights come on they see each other for the first time. Father and daughter. He punishes her for running away by forcing her to fulfill his sexual desire again. He then takes her home. If she won’t act as his daughter, she’ll certainly act as his pet.
